Real NQ, MNQ, ES and MES one-minute bars, replayed with no invented prices. Each candle is stepped through open, extremes and close; with a trade on, the move against you comes first, so a stop and a target inside one candle resolve to the stop. Fills are simulated. Practice only, not advice.

What to replay

Pick a contract and a real recorded day. The replay starts at the time you choose and plays forward candle by candle.

Day and start time

How futures practice works

A real trading day, replayed. Nothing is live and no money is involved.

  1. Pick a contract and a day. MNQ is the small one: each tick is $0.50. NQ is ten times that.
  2. Press ▶ Play. The recorded day replays from your start time. Next bar beside it moves one candle at a time instead. Futures trade nearly around the clock: at the 5 PM close you can carry on into the 6 PM evening session.
  3. Tap Sell or Buy. A take-profit and a stop-loss are attached for you; drag their lines on the chart to move them.
  4. Stay inside the account rules. It's scored like a funded-account evaluation: reach the profit target without losing more than the trailing drawdown.

Account rules & costs

Your own guard rail, available on every account type and kept when you switch. You get warnings at 50%, 75% and 90% and a heads-up when you reach it, but you're never locked out: practice needs repetition.
